subject: Debrief -> Approval path for offer: Aurora Cho (Senior Inference Engineer)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Debrief: Aurora Cho — Senior Inference Engineer

Hi team,

Quick debrief from the loop with Aurora (interviews yesterday): overall very strong. Highlights:
- System design was excellent (scale + KV cache management).
- Runtime debugging task completed with solid tradeoff discussion.
- Behavioral fit: collaborative, clear product sense.

Interviewers' signal: 4/5 technical, 4/5 system design, culture fit 4/5. Recommendation: hire at Senior Inference Engineer level (IC3 -> IC4 discussion). Candidate expressed flexibility on title but asked about comp range earlier in the process.

Given market comps and the candidate's current package (shared in comp_worksheet.xlsx), I recommend we propose a range that is slightly above our standard IC3 band to avoid losing them to larger peers: target total comp range $260k–$300k (split between base + target bonus + equity). I attached the interview notes (aurora_interview_notes.pdf) and a preliminary comp worksheet for review.

Action requested: Lauren can you confirm manager endorsement for the elevated range? Karthik please advise on leveling exception path. Stephanie — if you concur, we should route to Marcus (Finance) for final sign-off and prep an offer doc draft.

-Jonas

Attachments:
- aurora_interview_notes.pdf (interviewer bullets)
- comp_worksheet.xlsx (current comp, proposed comps)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Debrief: Aurora Cho — Senior Inference Engineer

On Wed, Jul 15, 2026 at 09:12, Jonas Weber wrote:
> Quick debrief from the loop with Aurora (interviews yesterday): overall very strong.

Agree with Jonas — strong hire. Additional color: Aurora has recent offers from two mid-market infra teams; they flagged base as the decision criteria. If we keep base too low, they'll ask for more equity instead and may lean to a cash-first offer.

Manager note: I'm prepared to own the hiring plan and manager endorsement. I'm comfortable with a proposed base in the $220k–$240k band with target bonus 20–25% and RSUs to make the total reach ~$275k mid. If Finance needs firm numbers, I'm ok signing off to escalate to Marcus for a one-off band elevation.

Lauren
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Debrief: Aurora Cho — Senior Inference Engineer

Thanks for the notes. A couple of guardrails from Talent Ops/Comp:
- We should avoid band compression for existing IC3s on the team. Any elevation should be justified with unique contribution or market loss risk.
- For exception requests >$270k TCC, we need director-level and Finance approval.

Please include a short justification paragraph in the comp worksheet that calls out: competing offers, unique infra experience (KV cache + compilation), and immediate impact in the serving runtime. That will speed approvals.

Also tagging Marcus in the next step would be helpful for clarity on budget.

Karthik
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval path and next steps for Aurora Cho

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. I agree Aurora is a priority candidate and we should move decisively. Proposed path:
1) Manager endorsement (Lauren) — confirmed in thread.
2) Director sign-off (me) — granting a level exception to Senior/IC3->IC4 for this hire given the market signal.
3) Finance approval (Marcus) — confirm the comp structure fits budget and sign off on the uplift.
4) Legal/Talent Ops to review offer language and benefits.

Jonas — please add the short justification paragraph into comp_worksheet.xlsx (one paragraph, market context + impact). Once that's added, Marcus, can you review and confirm whether Finance can support the proposed total comp in the worksheet? If yes, I will prepare the draft offer-letter and route for e-signature.

Objectives/timeline: would like to have finance answer by EOD tomorrow so we can get a verbal out to Aurora by Friday.

-Stephanie
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval path and next steps for Aurora Cho

Thanks — I reviewed the worksheet and the justification. Finance position: we can approve an uplift within the following constraints:
- Base up to $235,000; target bonus 20%; equity grant sized to bring the midpoint to ~$275,000 TCC.
- If the package needs to exceed $285,000 TCC, we need executive review and budget reallocation approval.

Please finalize the comp components (base, bonus %, equity grant) and I will mark as approved in Workday so Talent Ops can generate the offer letter. Also add anticipated start date and a note about relocation support if applicable.

Marcus

Attachment referenced:
- comp_worksheet.xlsx (updated with Finance notes)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Aurora Cho <aurora.cho@gmail.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah@brightpath.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft offer and next steps — Aurora Cho (Senior Inference Engineer)

Aurora —

Great speaking with you again. We're excited to move forward and would like to extend a formal offer for Senior Inference Engineer. Attached is the draft offer letter (offer-letter-draft.docx) for your review. High-level components:
- Base salary: $230,000
- Target bonus: 20%
- Equity: RSU grant sized to bring mid-target total comp to approx. $275,000 TCC
- Start date: flexible, suggested Aug 24, 2026

This is a draft; if anything in the offer needs clarification we can discuss. We will send the official e-signature package via DocuSign once you confirm verbal acceptance. Below is a link to the offer doc in Drive and the DocuSign envelope (will be live once we finalize wording).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-offers
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-aurora-cho

Sarah — please coordinate with Aurora on a convenient time for a verbal review and next steps. Team, I will update Workday with Marcus's approval so Talent Ops can generate the official packet.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- offer-letter-draft.docx (draft offer for review)
From: Aurora Cho <aurora.cho@gmail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah@brightpath.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer and next steps — Aurora Cho (Senior Inference Engineer)

Hi Stephanie and team —

Thank you — I appreciate the quick follow-up and the clarity. The numbers look good at a high level. I'd like to schedule a quick call to go through the equity breakdown and start date. I'm available today after 2pm PT or Monday morning.

Thanks,
Aurora
